title: Cron lab
description: Build cron expressions visually, read them in plain English and check when they run next.
needs: an object with crons ([{ id, expression, timezone, from, expect_next }]), at least one: from is the ISO time the runs count from ("" for 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z) and expect_next the ISO time the first run should be ("" for none)
